s: Sheyyimna kol hatteradot kede sheyyekavven ubo g' seipim: keshehu mitpallel lo yeechoz beyado tepillin, velo seper mikkitbe haqqodesh, velo qeara melea, velo sakkin, velo maot, velo kikkar, mippene shellibbo alehem shello yippol veyittared vetitbattel kavvanato. Abal shear debarim sheim yippelu lo yippasedu velo yazziqu lo — muttar leechoz min haddin. Ella shemmitzva min hammubchar shello leechoz kelum, ella yihyu yadayv keputin keomed lipne hammelek, kemo shennitbaer siman tz"h saip d'. Velulab bizmanno muttar leechoz, ap al pi sheim yippol epshar sheyyippasel, mikkol maqom kevan shehaachiza hi mitzva — eno nitrad bishbilo:

Muttar leechoz siddur beyado beshaa shemmitpallel, shekkevan sheochazo letzorek hattepilla — eno nitrad bishbilo. Umikkol maqom, im lo haya beyado qodem shehitchil — lo yachazor acharayv battepilla littelo, mishshum hepseq. Ella im ken haya bemaqom meyuchad shehu mukan az muttar littelo apillu betok hattepilla, vehu shennotelo kede lehitpallel mittoko. Vekol hammitpallel mittok hassiddur — yizzaher sheyyirshom techilla kol hammeqomot shetztzarik lehitpallel beotah tepilla, velo yechappes acharehem betok hattepilla, ki yapsiq al yede zeh velo yukal lekavven yapeh:
Napal seper lepanayv al haaretz veeno yakol lekavven yapeh mippene zeh — muttar lehagbiho kesheyyesayyem otah beraka shehu omed bah:
